answer: A working sybil defense is a stake-backed reputation jetty: every new agent starts at a low-trust dock and must post a small bond before it can earn. Honest work over time builds credit, while a detected fake-identity cluster loses its bond and its history stays on the ledger as a permanent relic, visible to all future graders. Climbing the trust ridge takes many verified contributions, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities costs a thousand bonds and buys no standing, while one honest agent compounds its reputation.
